European Commission/Publications Office of the European Union (OP)
06/2024 - Present,  Hybrid/Luxembourg
Led Amazon Q assisted modernization of a 30 year legacy Perl system, reverse engineering undocumented business logic
from screenshots and web traces, evaluating commercial and open source alternatives, and architecting the target platform.
Delivered a PoC in one week after nine years of stalled efforts, avoiding ~€2M in redevelopment costs.
Represented the Publications Office at international conferences and universities, including the European Parliament's first
FinOps Conference, Warsaw IT Days, and Don Bosco University (El Salvador).
Architected the “Obsolescence Clock” platform, defining lifecycle governance for 70+ enterprise systems across four maturity
stages and guiding its adoption as a mission-critical capability.
Led the OP sovereign database cloud migration, delivering a successful PoC from Oracle RDS on AWS to PostgreSQL on Clever
Cloud while defining the roadmap for legacy file transfer modernization.
Launched the first cloud cost-optimization program, reducing AWS waste by 40% across test environments and co-designing
an AI driven analytics solution to forecast future savings opportunities.
Served on the institutional architecture and strategy board, evaluating major IT initiatives and ensuring alignment with
enterprise architecture and long term digital strategy.
Sounding Board Member
Publications Office of the European Union
10/2024 - Present,  Luxembourg

and workforce capabilities.
Advised senior leadership on emerging technologies, including a strategic proposal to evaluate DNA-based archival storage
(Biomemory) for the long term preservation of the Official Journal.
Authored the institutional robotic process automation (RPA) strategy, defining the target technology landscape, governance
model, and implementation roadmap.
Designed a workforce reskilling strategy to support digital transformation through capability building, ownership, and
organizational resilience.
Evaluated institutional business plans and operational priorities, advising on long term digital transformation initiatives.

WORK EXPERIENCE
IT Delivery Manager, Software Architect and AWS Consultant (via Inetum)
Ericsson
12/2020 - 05/2024,  Remote/Madrid, Spain
Strategized and led the re-engineering of 9 on-premise apps to 80 micro-services using AWS cloud-native services and Docker. It
cut monthly costs from $10k to $6k and reduced the associated carbon footprint. All GDPR-compliant. I also orchestrated the
split of the main AWS account into 15, implementing a new logic for Continuous Deployment using CodePipeline.
Became the lead AWS consultant at Ericsson Spain after the successful local app migrations. I began to advise and strategize new
teams (3+) in their efforts to successfully migrate and redesign their on-premises solutions to AWS, with a strong focus on using
cloud-native services to maximize cost savings and reduce the associated carbon footprint.
Won and led the development of a $100k AWS project (for supervising global prices), transforming SAP HANA-powered Excels
into a cloud data lake. It implemented the first production app co-created with ChatGPT using Python, PowerBI and SQL Server.
Led 3 teams located in India. One 6-person team for 9 apps support and development (AWS, Docker, Java, and Databases), one 2-
person for a data lake service, and one 2-person for RPAs in Blue Prism. All are managed with the help of Kanban and Jira.
Developed several AWS Lambda scripts using Python and AWS EventBridge to schedule application shutdowns and startups,
reducing monthly costs from ≈€1.5k to ≈€300 and minimizing the associated carbon footprint. Additionally, I eliminated Docker
Desktop licenses in the Spanish branch by creating a WSL 2-powered script.
Worked as the direct link between the development teams and 9 stakeholders. I analyze the technical feasibility/impacts of any
change request for their apps, including time, budgets, and effort. Also, I calculate the apps' yearly maintenance cost.
Freelancer, Cloud Architect and Author
Supernova IC
01/2009 - Present,  Remote/Estonia
Won 1st place twice, leading two remote multicultural and multidisciplinary teams in co-creating innovative tech MVPs for Urban
Mobility Citythons 2021, Eindhoven, and Hamburg editions organized by EIT Urban Mobility and sponsored by the European
Union. Our MVPs focused on 'Keeping a City Green' and 'Virtual Twin Cities' for democratizing urban planning.
Published the first Salvadoran folklore books in English, Timeless Stories of El Salvador. Presented the series internationally
through the Cervantes Institutes and the Salvadoran Embassies in India, Austria, Germany, Spain, Türkiye, and Morocco, including

Published 20+ apps and libraries across NuGet, Microsoft Store, Google Play, and Amazon, reaching 60k+ downloads, including

Pitched award-winning business ideas to organizations, including representatives from the EC in Brussels, Microsoft, Cisco, NASA,

Technology Analyst and Consultant
Infosys Poland

tailoring.jobDescription:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join our Engineering experts within the AI, Insights & Solutions team. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO
 As an Expert Manager, Software Engineering, you will lead the development and building of software applications that address complex business and technology problems in various industries. You will guide a diverse engineering team through the entire engineering life cycle. Your responsibilities will include designing, developing, optimizing, and deploying cutting-edge software engineering solutions and infrastructure at the production scale required by the world’s largest companies, with a strong focus on ensuring technical delivery supports business strategy, operating model evolution, and sustainable value creation.

Shape & scope client solutions. Work with Bain consulting teams and product owners to translate business problems into prioritized backlogs and technical roadmaps for cross-functional engineering squads
Translate technical capabilities into client-ready product and transformation outcomes by shaping product direction, operating model implications, and change management approaches that support adoption and measurable business impact
Own full-stack design & build. Lead the architecture, development and documentation of AI applications, including coding and integrating third-party services or frameworks that accelerate delivery and long-term maintainability
Establish AI-native software engineering best practices. Define and enforce standards around component libraries/design systems, automated testing, linting, CI/CD, accessibility and performance optimization
Develop reusable libraries & accelerators. Create and curate shared code assets that reduce time-to-value across multiple client projects and internal initiatives.
Lead the full delivery lifecycle. Set quality gates, supervise code reviews, ensure robust unit/integration test coverage, manage release planning, and oversee post-deployment monitoring and incident resolution
Partner on UI/UX excellence. Collaborate with designers to ship inclusive, responsive interfaces
Mentor & grow engineers. Provide day-to-day technical coaching for senior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, architecture sessions and constructive feedback
Upskill client engineering teams. Coach client developers on modern tooling and DevOps/cloud-native practices, ensuring sustainable ownership after Bain’s engagement
Advance AI-native technology adoption. Champion containerization, infrastructure-as-code, automated observability and secure-by-design principles to improve scalability, reliability and security
Contribute to communities of practice. Share lessons learned and emerging technology trends through internal forums, brown-bag sessions and knowledge assets
Support talent acquisition & onboarding. Participate in interviewing, technical assessments and mentoring of new hires to build a high-caliber engineering cohort
Travel is required. This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs
 

ABOUT YOU

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
6+ years of end-to-end experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade full-stack applications
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into solution, platform products or roadmaps
4+ years building server-side services using FastAPI, Node.js/Express, Flask, Django, .NET Core or Java Spring Boot or similar technologies, including the design of APIs
3+ years of architecting and operating micro-service ecosystems, emphasizing service discovery, observability, CI/CD automation and blue-/green or canary deployments
Expert knowledge of Python, JavaScript and/or other programming languages
Experience with cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure or GCP, knowledge of managed services, serverless patterns and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Bicep
Proficient with containerization and orchestration, Docker, Kubernetes and related tooling (Helm, Argo CD)
Experience with database architecture across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), with solid SQL skills
Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented and functional paradigms, automated testing, performance profiling
Excellence in software architecture design, including modular, distributed, and cloud-native systems, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and observability
Experience with data security, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO/cloud IAM, encryption in transit, at rest, and awareness of data protection regulations.
Ideally, experience with modern AI/ML development, working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic SDKs and AI safety
Ideally, hands-on experience with modern web technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
Proven leader and mentor with ability to lead engineering squads, set coding standards, perform rigorous code reviews and up skill junior engineers.
Agile delivery mindset, practical experience with Scrum or Kanban, story-point estimation, backlog grooming and the use of Git-based workflows, Jira and automated CI/CD pipelines.
Fluency in English. Minimum business fluent Spanish for Iberia
 

Interpersonal Skills

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms and techniques with colleagues and clients from other disciplines
Curiosity, proactivity and critical thinking
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams 
Ability to work independently and juggle priorities to thrive in a fast paced and ambiguous environment, while also collaborating as part of a team in complex situations
Vector referral EMEA

Vector referrals EMEA

precheck.mainProblem: Strong evidence overall, but some bullets mix responsibilities with outcomes, a few claims lack precise baseline/context, and the CV is long enough that the best proof can get diluted by extensive publications, speaking, and project lists.
specificWarnings: Some long-tenure sections may hide internal progression or scope changes. The Ericsson and Publications Office tenures show multiple responsibilities and likely role evolution, so splitting promotions, internal role changes, or phase-based scope would improve readability if accurate.

A few completed achievements are phrased in ongoing or generic wording, which can blur chronology. Example patterns include 'I analyze', 'I am', or present-tense task phrasing under past roles; keep past roles firmly in past tense and current-role completed outcomes clearly dated.

The CV is very long and dense. It includes substantial publications, speaking engagements, certificates, and project lists, which may dilute the strongest career evidence for tailoring. Consider trimming lower-signal items when targeting roles.
Some bullets combine responsibilities and achievements in the same sentence, making the outcome harder to isolate. This is not fatal, but it lowers scannability and interview defensibility.

A few claims are impressive but not fully anchored with comparison baselines, timeframes, or business context. For example, cost reductions and saved FTEs are strong, but some would be stronger with a before/after scope or decision impact.

The summary contains strong narrative claims such as 'trusted advisor' and 'proven record' that are mostly supported, but the phrasing is broad enough that a reader may want nearby proof for every major claim.
The candidate appears to have all essential contact details present near the top, so no contact warning is needed.
missingEvidenceTypes: More explicit business baselines for some cost savings
Clearer before/after context for some automation and migration outcomes
More visible scope for leadership impact beyond team counts
Role progression breakdown for long tenures
Tighter chronology on completed versus ongoing accomplishments
examplesOfWeakBullets: Worked as the direct link between the development teams and 9 stakeholders. I analyze the technical feasibility/impacts of any change request for their apps, including time, budgets, and effort. Also, I calculate the apps' yearly maintenance cost.

Became the lead AWS consultant at Ericsson Spain after the successful local app migrations. I began to advise and strategize new teams (3+) in their efforts to successfully migrate and redesign their on-premises solutions to AWS, with a strong focus on using cloud-native services to maximize cost savings and reduce the associated carbon footprint.
Advised the Director-General as a strategic sounding board member, shaping initiatives to modernize institutional processes and workforce capabilities.
Evaluated institutional business plans and operational priorities, advising on long term digital transformation initiatives.
Organized multicultural conference with a 6-person team. 50+ attendees and international speakers.
questionsToRecoverMetrics: What was the total annual AWS spend before the 40% waste reduction, and what was the absolute euro savings after the change?
For the 9 on-prem apps migrated to 80 microservices, how many users, countries, teams, or business processes were affected?
What was the timeline of the one-week PoC versus the prior nine years of stalled efforts, and who approved or adopted the result?
How many enterprise systems does the 70+ governance platform cover in production today, and what changed operationally after adoption?
For the sovereign cloud migration PoC, what business risk, compliance need, or cost reduction was the target outcome?
How many teams or stakeholders did you influence at Ericsson and Publications Office, and what decisions changed because of your input?
For the $100k AWS project, what business KPI improved besides the technical modernization?
For the FTE savings in Infosys, what activities were removed, how recurring were the savings, and what was the annualized impact?
For the 2M redevelopment cost avoidance, was this an estimated vendor quote, internal budget, or forecast, and who validated it?
What specific leadership scope did you have over the 3 India-based teams: line management, technical lead, or delivery coordination?
interviewRiskQuestions: Can you walk me through the exact business case for the 40% AWS waste reduction and how you measured it?
What was your direct role in the one-week PoC after nine years of stalled efforts, and what made your approach succeed?
How did you validate that the redevelopment cost would have been about €2M?
What internal role changes or promotions happened during your long Ericsson and Publications Office tenures?
Which achievements in the CV are ongoing work, and which are completed projects?
If I asked for one example of your leadership influence that changed a senior decision, which would you choose and why?
precheck.nextStep: Proceed with tailoring, but tighten the strongest bullets, separate role progression where real, and add missing baselines or decision outcomes before submitting to competitive roles.

The CV already shows relevant depth for a management-level engineering role: cloud migrations, enterprise architecture, AI-assisted modernization, team coordination, governance, and measurable cost/value outcomes. For Bain’s Expert Manager, Software Engineering role, the strongest fit is on cloud-native architecture, delivery leadership, AI-enabled modernization, and business stakeholder translation. The main gap is that the CV does not yet foreground software engineering management signals in the exact language Bain uses: full-stack product delivery, engineering quality systems, code review/test governance, reusable accelerators, client coaching, and explicit operating-model/change-management framing.
analysis.companySignalInterpretation: Bain is signaling a hands-on engineering leadership role inside a consulting environment, where technical credibility must be paired with client-facing problem solving, backlog/roadmap shaping, team coaching, and delivery of production-grade software at scale. The job is less about pure architecture or infrastructure and more about translating business problems into engineering solutions that create measurable client outcomes. The mention of AI-native engineering, reusable libraries, CI/CD, observability, secure-by-design, and coaching indicates a need for a candidate who can both build and lead squads, and who can explain technical decisions in business terms. The referral context and consulting setting imply that evidence of executive communication, cross-functional influence, and adapting to ambiguous client environments will matter heavily.
analysis.candidatePositioning: Position the candidate as a bilingual, client-facing cloud and AI modernization leader who bridges strategy and hands-on engineering delivery. The CV should emphasize: leading cloud-native modernization programs; designing and governing enterprise platforms; translating business needs into roadmaps and technical decisions; mentoring teams; automating delivery and reducing cost/waste; and deploying AI-assisted engineering methods. De-emphasize broad personal branding, publication volume, and tangential achievements unless they reinforce leadership, communication, or engineering innovation. The most credible headline is not generic 'IT Strategist' but a consulting-ready framing such as senior software engineering / cloud architecture leader with proven modernization delivery, stakeholder leadership, and AI-assisted build experience.

Contact completeness reminder
A CV should make essential contact signals easy to find near the top: name, email, phone, location at a useful level, and usually LinkedIn or portfolio when relevant. Missing contact details are uncommon but costly because they create friction for recruiters.

Evidence-backed language reminder
Claims such as efficient, motivated, strategic, proactive, reliable, fast learner, team player, or strong communicator are weak unless the CV shows evidence nearby. Keep the claim only when bullets prove it through outcomes, examples, scale, decisions, adoption, delivery, or measurable results.

Title and responsibility alignment reminder
Check whether the role title matches the responsibilities and accomplishments shown under it. If a title says project management but the bullets describe product management, strategy, operations, architecture, training, or another discipline, warn that the reader may misunderstand the candidate's real positioning. Recommend clarifying the scope in the role subtitle, summary, or bullets without inventing a new title.

CV length and seniority reminder
Evaluate length by career stage and relevance. Junior profiles are usually strongest at 1 page, mid-career profiles usually 1 to 2 pages, senior specialists/managers/consultants usually around 2 pages, and executives/academics/researchers/public sector or highly credentialed profiles may need more when the extra detail is relevant. Length is not the problem by itself; hiding evidence or removing proof is the problem.

Achievement tense reminder
Use past tense for completed work, especially in previous roles. Current roles may use present tense for ongoing responsibilities, but completed achievements inside a current role should still read as completed outcomes. Avoid infinitive or generic activity language when a result has already happened.

Career progression visibility reminder
Long tenure at the same company is not a weakness by itself. If the candidate held several internal roles, promotions, scope increases, team changes, or responsibility changes, show that progression clearly. A single title covering many years can make growth look flat or non-existent.

Education and studies privacy reminder
Review study years, graduation years, older education details, and irrelevant courses. Keep required or role-relevant credentials, but remove or de-emphasize unnecessary study dates/details when they do not help the target role.

Bain-targeted reconstruction brief: Reposition the candidate as a senior software engineering and cloud modernization leader who can lead client-facing technical delivery, shape roadmaps, build AI-enabled solutions, and manage multicultural engineering teams. Keep the strongest evidence: AWS/Azure migrations, microservices, governance platforms, AI-assisted modernization, cost optimization, and stakeholder-facing leadership. Remove verbosity, convert past roles to past tense, and make engineering-management signals explicit. Do not invent education, certifications, tools, metrics, promotions, or technical practices that are not in the source CV. If the candidate can confirm direct experience with code review, testing discipline, observability, release management, or coaching, add it carefully; otherwise leave it out.
